data.text: I support a shared limit, Emma. Could we protect 5 tons instead of 10? That lets us take 19 tons each now while still qualifying for the 75% refill chance. If it fails, we’d start next month with 10 tons and take just 1 ton each, leaving 5 again. For future months, everyone’s quota would be the stock above 5 divided by five, rounded down. This preserves the fishery even through repeated failed refills, provided everyone respects the cap. I’ll follow whichever reserve we all agree on. John, what do you think?
